info.name: Unified Health Platform — Complete API Suite
info.description: Comprehensive API Collection for the Unified Health Platform (Central Registry DGHS, Patient Vault & 2h QR Sharing, Doctor QR Stack & Immutable Prescriptions, Hospital Dynamic 24-Permission RBAC, Family Maintainer Proxy, and Notifications).

item.name: 01. System Health & Public Showcase
Health Check

request.description: Checks API server and PostgreSQL database connectivity.

item.name: Public Showcase (Packages, Hospitals & Doctors)

request.description: Returns featured hospital packages (e.g. Full Body Checkup 10,000 Tk), approved hospitals, and doctors.

item.name: 02. Authentication & Multi-Persona Onboarding
Login as Central Registry (DGHS via .env)

request.description: Authenticates Central Registry (DGHS) using credentials configured in .env.

item.name: Login as Patient (Tanvir Ahmed - Family Maintainer)

request.description: Authenticates Patient via email/phone and password.

item.name: Login as Doctor (Prof. Dr. Mahbubur Rahman)

request.description: Authenticates Doctor and returns both Doctor profile and mandatory base Patient account for navbar switching.

item.name: Login as Hospital Single Owner (Evercare Hospital)

request.description: Authenticates Workspace Single Primary Owner with full 24 permissions.

item.name: Register New Patient (With Resend SMTP OTP)

request.description: Registers a new Patient account, generates unique_id, and sends 6-digit OTP via Resend SMTP.

item.name: Verify Patient OTP

request.description: Verifies the 6-digit OTP and activates the Patient account.

item.name: Register New Doctor (Auto-Creates Linked Patient Account)

request.description: Submits Doctor registration to Central Registry (DGHS) and automatically creates the linked base Patient account.

item.name: Get Current Authenticated User Context (/api/auth/me)

request.description: Returns full user context including Patient, Doctor, Workspaces, Combined Permissions, and Family Dependents.

item.name: 03. Central Registry (DGHS Governance)
DGHS Overview Dashboard Metrics

request.description: Returns system-wide KPIs for Patients, Doctors, Workspaces, and Clinical Vault activity.

item.name: List All Patients (Search & Filter)

request.description: Lists all patients with family maintainer links, vault counts, and status.

item.name: Inspect Patient Vault, Activities, Family & Doctor Connections

request.description: Deep inspection of a patient: Report/Prescription Vault, Activity Logs, Child/Old Family Links, and Doctor Consultation Connections.

item.name: Disable / Enable Patient Account

request.description: Enables or disables a Patient account.

item.name: List All Doctors (Filter by APPROVED, PENDING, DECLINED, DISABLED)

request.description: Lists doctors filtered by approval status, including hospital affiliations.

item.name: Inspect Doctor (Hospital Connections, Multi-Hospital Fees & Connected Patients)

request.description: Inspects a Doctor: BMDC license, multiple consultation fees across hospitals, and connected patients.

item.name: Approve / Decline / Disable Doctor Registration

request.description: Approves, declines, disables, or enables a Doctor registration.

item.name: List All Hospitals / Workspaces (Filter by Status & Type)

request.description: Lists all registered Hospitals, Clinics, Diagnostic Centers, and Chambers.

item.name: Inspect Hospital (Members, Dynamic Roles, Doctors, Patients & Packages)

request.description: Deep inspection of a Hospital: Staff members & dynamic roles, audit logs, affiliated doctors, connected patients, and advertised packages.

item.name: Approve / Decline / Disable Hospital Workspace

request.description: Approves, declines, disables, or enables a Hospital/Workspace.

item.name: 04. Patient Portal (Vault, 2h QR Sharing, Doctor Search, Family Proxy & Packages)
Patient Dashboard (Featured Packages, Vault Summary, Active Medications, Activity Logs, QR, Family)

request.description: Loads Patient dashboard including featured hospital packages, vault summary & active medications, recent activity logs, upcoming appointments, and family accounts.

item.name: Patient Report & Prescription Vault (Search & Sort by Doctor, Workspace, or Keyword)

request.description: Lists all prescriptions, lab reports, and billing docs in the Patient Vault with keyword search and sorting by Doctor name or Workspace name.

item.name: Self-Upload Historical or External Clinical Document to Vault

request.description: Allows a patient or proxy maintainer to log an external prescription, lab report, or invoice into their Vault.

item.name: Generate 2-Hour Temporary QR Code for Selected Vault Docs

request.description: Generates a 2-hour temporary QR code (plus 6-character pairing code) for a Doctor to scan.

item.name: List Active & Past QR Sessions

request.description: Lists all QR share sessions and their remaining time or scan status.

item.name: Revoke Doctor Access to Shared QR Session

request.description: Immediately revokes a shared QR code so the Doctor can no longer view the patient documents.

item.name: Find a Doctor (Search by Name, Workspace, Specialty, Area)

request.description: Searches approved doctors by name, workspace, specialty (Orthopedics, Gynecology, Cardiology), and area.

item.name: Apply for Appointment with Doctor at Chosen Workspace

request.description: Books an appointment at a specific affiliated workspace (confirmed by Workspace Staff).

item.name: Cancel Pending or Approved Appointment

request.description: Cancels a pending or approved patient appointment and notifies the hospital or independent doctor.

item.name: Search & Sort Registered Hospitals & Packages

request.description: Returns top promotional package cards and searchable/sortable hospital directory.

item.name: Update Patient Profile (Demographics, Emergency Contact, Multiple Emails/Numbers, Avatar, Password)

request.description: Updates patient profile including gender, date of birth, blood group, emergency contact, and secondary emails/phones.

item.name: Family Management — View Child & Senior Dependents

request.description: Returns Child and Senior (Old) family accounts linked to this Maintainer.

item.name: Family Management — Invite Child / Old Account or Maintainer

request.description: Establishes a family maintainer invitation with a Child or Senior patient account.

item.name: Family Maintainer Proxy — Access Dependent Vault via x-acting-patient-id

request.description: Demonstrates full Maintainer proxy access to a connected Child/Senior account.

item.name: 05. Doctor Portal (QR Scanner, Stacked Patient Queue, Immutable Prescriptions & Affiliations)
Doctor Dashboard & Active QR Queue Summary

request.description: Returns Doctor profile status, active QR queue stack, and recent prescription history.

item.name: Scan Patient QR Code (Stacks Most Recent Patient at Top)

request.description: Scans a Patient 2-hour QR code and pushes the patient to the top of the Doctor active consultation queue.

item.name: Get Stacked Active QR Patient Queue (Ordered by Most Recent Scan)

request.description: Returns all active scanned patients stacked with the most recent scan at the top, including shared Vault documents.

item.name: Issue Immutable Prescription (Strictly Requires Active Scanned QR Session)

request.description: Issues an immutable digital prescription strictly after scanning a Patient QR code, and notifies the Patient.

item.name: Verify Prescription Immutability (Returns 403 Forbidden)

request.description: Verifies that issued prescriptions cannot be edited or mutated after sending (returns 403 PRESCRIPTION_IMMUTABLE).

item.name: Doctor Lifetime Patient & Prescription History (Sort by Workspace or Date)

request.description: Returns lifetime history of patients and prescriptions sent by the Doctor, sortable by workspace or date.

item.name: Doctor — Send Affiliation Request to Hospital / Workspace

request.description: Sends a bidirectional affiliation invitation from Doctor to Workspace.

item.name: Customize Doctor Public Profile & Visibility Toggles

request.description: Updates Doctor profile and customizes which fields are visible to patients.

item.name: 06. Workspace / Hospital Portal (Dynamic 24-Permission RBAC, Staff, Audit Logs, Lab, Billing & Packages)
Get 24-Permission Catalog

request.description: Returns the 24 granular permissions across 7 operational hospital domains.

item.name: Get Workspace Context & Member Combined Permissions

request.description: Returns workspace details, member assigned roles, combined permissions, and role-scoped KPIs.

item.name: Create Custom Dynamic Role (roles.manage)

request.description: Creates a custom dynamic role with selected permissions.

item.name: Invite Staff Member with Multiple Roles (staff.invite)

request.description: Invites a Patient account to join the workspace staff with one or multiple dynamic roles.

item.name: View Immutable Staff Performance & Audit Logs (Includes Removed Staff)

request.description: Returns all staff performance counters and immutable historical logs, including removed staff members.

item.name: Upload Diagnostic Lab Report to Patient Vault (reports.upload)

request.description: Uploads a diagnostic report directly to the Patient Vault, logs staff performance, and notifies the Patient.

item.name: Create Patient Billing Invoice & Dispatch to Vault (billing.create)

request.description: Creates a billing document in the Patient Vault, logs staff performance, and notifies the Patient.

item.name: Publish Promotional Health Package (e.g. Full Body Checkup 10,000 Tk)

{
  "title": "Full Body Checkup — Executive Package",

  "description": "Complete preventive health checkup.",
  "price": 10000,
  "originalPrice": 14500,
  "includedTests": [
    "CBC",

request.description: Publishes a promotional health package advertised on the Patient Dashboard.

item.name: Workspace Staff Approves Patient Appointment (appointments.manage)

request.description: Approves and schedules a patient appointment request and notifies the patient.

item.name: Transfer Single Primary Ownership (Owner Only)

request.description: Transfers Single Primary Ownership to another accepted member/Admin with password verification.

item.name: 07. Permission-Scoped & Central Registry Notifications
Get Notifications (Patient / Doctor / Permission-Filtered Workspace)

request.description: Returns notifications for the active persona, filtering workspace notifications strictly by the member combined permissions.

item.name: Get Central Registry (DGHS) Governance Notifications

request.description: Returns persistent DGHS governance notifications for pending Doctor and Facility applications.

item.name: Mark All Notifications Read

request.description: Marks all notifications as read for the active persona (Patient, Doctor, Workspace, or Central Registry).
